description: Erect, branched herb, to 50 cm tall, basally slightly woody, stem subterete, glandular-pilose mainly along two opposite longitudinal lines. Leaves distributed along the stem, those of a pair subisomorphic, membranous, lanceolate, 1.2–4.3 x 0.6–1.5 cm, base acute or attenuate, apex acute to acuminate, margin serrulate and ciliate, lamina with 1 pair of lateral primary veins departing at the blade base, transverse veins inconspicuous, sparsely covered by minute glands, petioles 0.2–0.9 cm long, with sparse glandular hairs. Inflorescence a terminal 2–7-flowered scorpioid cyme, about 3 cm long, the peduncle 2.5–5.3 cm long, subtended by two asymmetrical bracteoles. Hypanthium suburceolate, about 6.5 mm long and 3 mm in diam.; calyx lobes triangular, ca 1 mm long; pedicels 2–3 mm long. Petals ovate with an acuminate tip, about 1.3 x 0.6 cm, purple. Stamens 3, anthers 10–13 mm long, yellow, pollen sacs with a distinct apical constriction, slightly prolonged and free at their base. Capsule urceolate, 8–9 mm long, crowned by the persistent calyx lobes, smooth.

description: Somewhat succulent rhizomatous herb, 10–18 cm tall, the stem thick and covered with conspicuous 4–6 mm long, reddish-brown setae, especially at the nodes. Leaves crowded near the ends of branches, thin-chartaceous, those of a pair isomorphic, ovate or elliptic-ovate, 3–8(–11) 1.5–4(–7) cm, base obtuse or cuneate, apex acute or obtuse, margin finely serrate, lamina in small leaves pinnately veined, in large leaves with 2–3 pairs of lateral primary veins arising at or above the blade base, above with sparse minute bristly hairs, below ± glabrous and often drying reddish or purplish, petioles 1–7 cm long. Inflorescences scorpioid cymes borne in the upper leaf axils, 1–9-flowered, peduncle 2–9 cm long. Hypanthium campanulate, 5–6 mm long; calyx lobes triangular, about 1 mm long; pedicels 2–3 mm long. Petals oblong or ovate, acuminate, 0.8–1 cm long, purple. Stamens 3, anthers 3.5–6 mm long, cordate at the base, yellow. Capsule narrowly funnel-shaped, 6–7 mm long, smooth.

description: Fronds rounded or pointed at apex, 3–10 mm long, 1–1.5 times as long as wide, flat or rarely gibbous, sometimes with a red spot in the center of the upper surface; roots up to 3 cm long, 1(–2) perforate the scale. Turions sometimes present, small (1–3 mm long), circular to reniform, brownish to olive, rootless. Flowers very rare, 1–2-ovulate. Fruit 1–1.5 mm long, laterally winged to the top; seed with 12–20 distinct ribs.

description: Evergreen tree, 6–20 m high; bark greyish brown, smooth, sparsely lenticelate; twigs cylindrical, rusty red tomentose then glabrescent, leaf scars distinct. Stipules awn-shaped, caducous. Leaves elliptic oblong to obovate-oblong, coriaceous, densely stellate hairy on both surfaces, then glabrous except along midrib and nerves on upper surface, densely hairy on lower surface; 10–30 x 3–15 cm, apex blunt acute, acuminate to caudate, base slightly cuneate or obtuse, secondary nerves 9–17 pairs, arched and anastomosing at margin, midrib, nerves and scalariform veins prominent on under surface and usually depressed on upper surface. Petiole 1–3 cm, swollen at both ends, geniculate, hairy. Inflorescence axillary and terminal, paniculate, lax and pendulous, 10–20 cm long; peduncle and pedicels filiform, the latter 5–15 mm long. Flower buds globose or ovoid, ca 5 x 3–4 mm, densely hairy. Calyx campanulate, 7–10 mm long, lobes ½ or down to base of tube, always cohering by hairs at apex, densely hairy; inner surface of calyx-tube glabrous. Male flowers with 10 stamens; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free carpels, on a glabrous gynandrophore; each globose, hairy, with 4–8 ovules; styles cohering, densely hairy; stigmas 5-lobed. Follicles (2–3–)5 on one stalk, oblong, narrowed at both ends, curved upward, 5–9 x 2–3 cm, densely dark brown tomentose. Seeds 3–6, ellipsoid, 1–1.5 x 1–1.2 cm, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia balanghas. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 626. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 20 m high; always with straight bole; bark light to dark brown, finely cracked; twigs reddish brown stellate hairs and prominently raised large leaf scars. Stipules ensiform, caducous. Leaves ovate, elliptic to elliptic-oblong, coriaceous, glabrous except along midrib on upper surface, long stellate hairy on under surface; 10–15 x 7–10 cm; apex broadly acute or rounded with abruptly acuminate; base broadly obtuse or subcordate, secondary nerves 8–12 pairs, straight, and anastomosing at margin. Petiole straight, 3–3.5 cm long, densely tomentose. Inflorescences terminal and at upper leaf scars, paniculate, pendulous, 10–15 cm long, much branched, densely stellate hairy; bracts narrow lanceolate, hairy. Flower buds globose; pedicel 3–4 mm long; hairy. Calyx campanulate to obconical; lobes ca ⅓ of calyx, erect; hairy on both surfaces. Male flowers 10(–12) stamens; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free ovaries. Ovary globose, pubescent; each locules with 10 ovules; style cohering, pubescent; stigmas 5 lobed. Follicles (3–)5, on one stalk, obovoid or pyriform, leathery, curved upward, densely brown tomentose, 4–10 x 2–5 cm. Seeds 5–10, ellipsoid, brown 11–13 x 5–6 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia cordata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 626. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 30 m high; always with straight clear bole; bark smooth, brownish-grey; twigs stout, pubescent, with prominently raised, large leaf scars. Stipules subulate, caducous. Leaves digitate, with (5–6–7) leaflets, leaflet elliptic or elliptic-oblong, coriaceous, glabrous or glabrescent; 10–20 x 3.5–6 cm, apex acute or cuspidate, base cuneate, secondary nerves arched, anastomosing and conspicuous on both sides; petiolules ca 5 mm long. Petiole 13–20 cm long, glabrous. Inflorescences terminal and at upper leaf scars, always lax, 10–30 cm long. Flower buds ovoid, ca 10 x 5 mm; pedicel 1–1.5 cm long, glabrous. Calyx obconical, 5-lobed; lobes spreading 10–15 x 3–4 mm, hairy especially near apex. Male flowers with 14(–15) stamens on a globose head; staminodes 14. Female flowers with 5 free carpels, each ovate, hairy, with ca 20-ovules; styles cohering, ca 5 mm long, hairy; stigmas 5 lobes or flattened. Follicles (3–)5 kidney-shaped, woody, brick-red and glabrous at maturity, 8–10 x 6–9 cm, dehiscing. Seeds ca 20, cylindrical, 2.5 by 1.3 cm, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia foetida. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 628. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 20 m high; bark dark grey, smooth; twigs slender, rusty tomentose then glabrescent, distinctly lenticelate and with prominent leaf scars. Stipules lanceolate, stellate hairy, caducous. Leaves elliptic, ovate or obovate, chartacous, glabrous except along midrib on upper surface, glaucous and sparsely stellate hairy by pale indumentum on under surface; 8–14 x 3.5–8.5 cm, apex blunt acute, base obtuse truncate to subcordate, secondary nerves 7–12 pairs, both midrib and nerves reddish brown and prominent on under surface. Petiole 2–3 cm., swollen at both ends and slightly geniculate, glabrescent. Inflorescences axillary and terminal paniculate, slender, up to 10 cm long, pendulous, densely stellate hairy; bracts narrow lanceolate, caducous. Flower buds globose, ca 2 x 2 mm; pedicel 2–3 mm long, hairy. Calyx obconical or campanulate, lobes lanceolate, as long as or up to ¾ of calyx, converging and usually cohering by hairy at apex, hairy on both surfaces; the inner surface of calyx-tube glabrous. Male flowers with 10 stamens; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free carpels, each globose, hairy, with 2–3 ovules; styles cohering, hairy; stigmas with 5 recurved lobes. Follicles 3–5, obovoid, 3 x 1.5 cm, leathery, curved upward, densely red tomentose outside. Seeds ellipsoid, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia gilva. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 630. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 15 m high; always with straight bole; bark grey, furrowed; twigs stout, rusty stellate hairy then glabrescent, with prominently raised large leaf scars. Stipules ensiform, caducous. Leaves broadly ovate to ovate-oblong, chartaceous, sparsely hairy on upper surface, long stellate hairy on under surface; 15–18 x 8–9 cm, apex acute or shortly cuspidate; base obtuse to slightly cordate, 3-nerved from base, secondary nerves 8–12 pairs, straight and anastomosing at margin. Petiole 2.5–6 cm, densely dark brown hairy; usually geniculate. Inflorescences terminal and at upper leaf scars, paniculate, erect, 5–13 cm long, nearly unbranched, densely curved hairy. Flower buds ovoid; pedicel 2–3 mm long; hairy. Calyx campanulate, lobes narrow triangular, first cohering at apex then spreading; hairy both surfaces; calyx-tube glabrous inside. Male flowers with 10(–12) stamens; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with (3–)5. Ovary globose with 6 ovules; style cohering, glabrous; stigmas (3-)5 lobes. Follicles (2–3–)5, on one stalk, each ensiform, leathery, densely soft hairy, 7–8 x 2.5–3.5 cm, curved upward, bright red. Seeds 4–6, ellipsoid, 1.5–2 x 1.5 cm, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia guttata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 630. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 20 m high; bark smooth, brownish-grey; twigs stout, densely hairy, with prominently raised large leaf scars. Stipules lanceolate, caducous. Leaves palmately lobed, nearly orbicular, in outline, deeply 5–7-lobed; lobes ± 1/1 or more of lamina, coriaceous or subcoriaceous, scabrid on upper surface, soft long-hairy ana glaucous on lower surface; 20–30 x 20–30 cm; apex acuminate to cuspidate; base deeply cordate 5 (7) nerved from base, nerves and veins prominent on lower surface. Petiole 20–30 cm long, hairy then glabrescent. Inflorescence terminal and at upper leaf scars, lax and pendulous, up to 35 cm long, reddish brown hairy. Flower buds ovoid ca 4 x 3 mm; pedicel ca 5 mm long, hairy. Calyx tubular or urceolate, lobes narrow triangular 2–3 x 1 mm, as long as calyx-tube; hairy outside. Male flowers with 10 stamens on a globose head; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free carpels, each ovoid, hairy, 5–6 ovules, styles cohering, ca 4 mm long, scattered with glandular hairs; stigmas flattened or with 5 lobes. Follicles 3–5, spreading horizontally, oblong, leathery, tomentose, ca 5 x 2 cm, dehiscing. Seeds, 3–5, ovoid, ca 15 x 12 mm, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia hypochroa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 633. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Evergreen shrub, 1–3 m high; bark brown, smooth, sparsely lenticellate; twigs cylindric, glabrous or glabrescent. Stipules lanceolate, caducous. Leaves oblong or elliptic, chartaceous to subcoriaceous, sparsely hairy then glabrescent; 8–22 by 3.5–6.5 cm, slightly narrow then caudate or cuspidate at apex, base obtuse or slightly cuneate; secondary nerves 10–17 pairs, arched and anastomosing well away from margin, midrib nerves and reticulate veins distinct on under surface. Petiole 1–5 cm, swollen and dark at both end, genicilate, glabrous. Inflorescence axillary on upper leaf scars and terminal, paniculate, pendulous, lax, 5–10 cm long, glabrescent; peduncle and pedicels filiform, the latter 1–2 cm long. Flower buds ovoid, 3–5 x 2–3 mm, glabrescent. Calyx 5, free, spreading, glabrous or glabrescent; sepals ovate-oblong, 6–8 x 1–2 mm. Male flowers with 10 stamens; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free carpels, each globose, hairy, 5–6 ovuled; styles cohering, hairy; stigmas with 5 reflexed lobes. Follicle (2–3–)5, oblong, narrowed at both ends, leathery, pubescent; 4–8 x 1.5–2 cm, curved upwards, red or dark brown. Seeds 3–5, ellipsoid, 12–15 x 7–8 mm, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia lanceolata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 635. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: This variety differs from var. lanceolata in buds oblong, 7–10 x 3–4 mm; mature flowers obconical; lobes 2–3 times length of calyx-tube, cohering at the tip or sometimes reflexed, calyx hairy on both surfaces, but glabrous on the upper part of tube.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia lanceolata coccinea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 635. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: This variety differs from var. lanceolata in rusty red twigs becoming glabrescent; leaves oblanceolate, up to 32 x 8 cm; calyx lobes 1–1.5 cm long, hairy externally.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia lanceolata principis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 638. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 30 m high; always with straight bole; buttresses up to 3 m high; bark smooth, greyish to greyish-brown; twigs stout, first rusty stellate hairy then glabrescent, with prominently raised large leaf scars. Stipules lanceolate, glabrous, caducous. Leaves broadly ovate or heart-shaped, chartaceous to sub-coriaceous, glabrescent, but hairy along nerves on upper surface, densely hairy on lower surface; 16–35 x 13–30 cm, apex blunt or broadly acute, base cordate, 3–(5)-nerved from base, secondary nerves 6–10 pairs, straight and gradually curved near margin, all nerves and scalariform veins prominent on lower surface and depressed on upper surface. Petiole 10–16 cm long, densely tomentose, straight and smooth. Inflorescences terminal and axillary, paniculate, much-branched, erect, 20–40 cm long; branches 2–8 cm long, hairy; bracts lanceolate, caducous. Flower buds globose; pedicels 2–3 mm long. Calyx obconical or campanulate; lobes erect or spreading, as long as calyx-tube, hairy on both surfaces. Male flowers with (5–)10 stamens; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free carpels, each globose, pubescent, with 2–17 ovules; styles cohering, sparsely hairy; stigmas 5 curved lobes. Follicles with 3–5, globose or ellipsoid, 5–6 x 4.5–5 cm, leathery woody; covered with red or dark brown tomentum. Seeds 1–9, ellipsoid, 12–20 by 8–12 mm, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia macrophylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 638. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Evergreen tree, up to 10 m high; twigs slender, glabrous. Stipules awn-shaped, caducous. Leaves broadly elliptic to elliptic-oblong, coriaceous, sparsely hairy then glabrescent on both surfaces; 15–30 6–14 cm, apex broadly acute with shortly acuminate, base obtuse, 3-nerved at base, secondary nerves 8–14 pairs, arched and anastomosing well away from the margin. Petiole 2–5 cm, glabrescent, swollen at both ends, geniculate. Inflorescence axillary and terminal, paniculate, pendulous, up to 30 cm long, with many long branches, glabrous or glabrescent. Flower buds ellipsoid, 3–5 x 2–3 mm; pedicel ca 1 cm long, glabrescent. Calyx campanulate to obconical, lobes narrow lanceolate, cohering by hairs at apex, ca ⅔ length of calyx-tube, long hairy along margin, otherwise glabrescent. Male flowers with 10 stamens on a globose head, at the end of a glabrous and slender androphore; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free carpels on a glabrous gynandrophore, each globose, hairy, with 5 ovules; styles cohering, sparsely hairy; stigmas with 5 reflexed lobes. Follicles 1–5, oblong, 8–10 x 3–4 cm, narrowed at both ends, reddish tomentose. Seeds 1–(4), ellipsoid, 3-3.5 x 2 cm, dark brown to black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia monosperma. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 641. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 30 m high; always with straight bole; bark greyish-brown, smooth; twigs cylindrical, red-brown stellate hairy, then glabrescent, leaf scars conspicuous; young shoots ferruginous-tomentose. Stipules lanceolate, caducous. Leaves elliptic-oblong, subcoriaceous, sparsely pubescent then glabrescent on both surfaces; 10–22 x 5.5–10 cm, apex acute or shortly acuminate, base obtuse, 3-nerved at base, secondary nerves slender, 8–15 pairs, arched and anastomosing well away from the margin. Petiole 2.5–10 cm, sparsely pubescent then glabrescent, swollen at both ends, geniculate. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, paniculate, erect, up to 15 cm long, branches 2–3 cm long, hairy then glabrescent. Flower buds globose; pedicel 1–5 mm long; hairy. Calyx urceolate, lobes linear-lanceolate, inflexed, as long as the tube, hairy outside and glabrous within. Male flowers with 10 stamens; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free carpels. Ovary globose, glabrous, 6-ovuled; styles cohering, glabrous; stigmas 5-lobed. Follicles (1–3)5 on one stalk, oblong, leathery, pubescent, 7–10 x 3–4 cm, curved upward, orange to bright red. Seeds 3–4, ellipsoid, 1.5–2 x 1.2 cm, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia parviflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 641. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 20 m high; with straight bole; bark smooth, grey; twigs stout, pubescent, with lenticels and prominently raised large leaf scars. Stipules lanceolate, caducous. Leaves digitate with 6–9 leaflets; leaflet oblanceolate, subcoriaceous, hairy especially on lower surface; 8–25 x 3–6.5 cm, apex acute, acuminate to cuspidate; base cuneate, secondary nerves parallel, anastomosing and prominent on lower surface. Petiole 10–30 cm long, glabrescent; petiolule 1–2 mm long. Inflorescence terminal and at upper leaf scars, lax, 20–30 cm long. Flower buds globose, ca 3 mm across; pedicels sessile or subsessile. Calyx campanulate, 5-lobed; lobes as long as calyx-tube, cohering by hairy at apex; 4–5 x 2–2.5 mm, hairy on both surfaces. Male flowers with 14–15 stamens; staminodes 14–15. Female flowers with 5 free carpels, each with ± 20 ovules; stigmas sessile with 5 lobes. Follicles (3–)5, thick leathery, kidney-shaped, greenish hairy and erect, both sides dehiscing, 4–5 x 2.5 cm. Seeds 20, white (young).
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia pexa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 644. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Differs from var. urena in the slender and pendulous inflorescences, up to 30 cm long; calyx with oblong lobes divided to or near base.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia urena thorelii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 646. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Deciduous tree, up to 20 m high; bark smooth, brownish-grey; twigs stout, densely hairy, with prominently raised large leaf scars. Stipules lanceolate, caducous. Leaves palmately lobed, nearly orbicular in outline, deeply 5–7 lobed; lobes ± 1/1 or more of lamina, coriaceous or subcoriaceous, scabrid on upper surface, soft long-hairy and pale on under surface, 20–30 x 20–30 cm; apex acuminate to cuspidate; base deeply cordate, 5–(7)-nerved from base; all nerves and veins prominent on under surface. Petiole 20–30 cm long, hairy then glabrescent. Inflorescences terminal and at upper leaf scars, lax and pendulous, up to 30 cm long, rusty-hairy. Flower buds ovoid, ca 4 x 3 mm; pedicel ca 5 mm, hairy. Calyx obconical or broadly campanulate, lobes ovate, 5–10 x 2–5 mm, more or as long as calyx tube, hairy outside. Male flowers with 10 stamens; anthers sessile; staminodes 10. Female flowers with 5 free carpels, hairy. Ovary ovate, with 5–6 ovules; style cohering, ± 4 mm long, hairy; stigmas flattened or with 5 lobes. Follicles 3–5, drooping, oblong, leathery, densely villous, ca 5 x 2 cm, dehiscent. Seeds 3–5, ovoid, ca 15 x 12 mm, black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sterculia villosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 649. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Evergreen tree, 5–15 m high, low-branched; bark grey, smooth; twigs densely stellate-hairy then glabrescent. Stipules lanceolate, 2–5 x 1–2 mm, glabrescent. Leaves elliptic, oblong to slightly lanceolate, 5–11 x 1.2–3 cm, coriaceous, glabrous above, sometimes stellate-pubescent beneath along midrib, apex acute to acuminate, base acute to slightly cuneate margin entire, often recurved; secondary nerves 6–10 pairs, arched and anastomosing well away form the margin, conspicuous on both sides. Flowers male, female or hermaphrodite, in spikes or racemes, 3–6-flowered. Stamens when present, 4–10. Ovary when present, enveloped by the receptacle, 2-locular, locule with one ovule. Capsule ellipsoid, woody, ca 1 x 1 cm, the lower half or whole surrounded by the receptacle.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Sycopsis dunnii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 408. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Evergreen tree, 15–30 m high; bark dark brown, shallowly fissured and flaking, twigs glabrous, thickened at the nodes. Stipules obovate to oblanceolate, thick, flattend, 1.5–2.5 x 1 cm, glabrescent. Leaves broadly ovate or tri-lobed, 5–16 x 4–12 cm, coriaceous, glabrous, apex acute, base obtuse, rounded or subcordate, margin entire or lobed; 3–5-nerved from base, impressed above, prominent on lower surface, secondary nerves 2–5 pairs, faintly distinct; petiole 2–6 cm long, glabrous, with a red tinge. Hermaphrodite flowers in globose heads, up to 1.5 cm diam, at or near end of shoots. Petals 2–7, linear to spathulate, 2–3 0.5 mm. Stamens 10–14. Ovary conical, half inferior, hairy, styles 2, glabrous. Capsules 7–11 per head, glabrous; head 2–2.5 cm diam, woody; stalk 1.5–2.5 cm. Seeds ellipsoid, fertile ones winged, sterile ones wingless.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Symingtonia populnea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 408. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomes elongate, 3–5 mm thick. Leaves 10–40 cm by 4–12 mm, 10–17-veined; margins entire. Staminate inflorescence with peduncles ca 3 cm long, 1-flowered; carpellate inflorescence with peduncles 1–1.5 cm long, 1-flowered. Staminate flowers with 3–12 stamens, pedicels 2–3 cm long; carpellate flowers subsessile, with 6 styles. Fruit light green, 2–2.5 by 1.4–3.2 cm, splitting into 8–20 valves; beak 1–2 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Thalassia hemprichii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 381. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Small tree, up to 10 m high; crown bushy. Leaves oblong, 17–28 x 7–10 cm, apex acute to broadly acute, base obtuse, sub-coriaceous, glabrescent; 3-nerved at base, midrib and nerves prominently ridged when dry. Inflorescences simple, on main stem and branches, 1–7-flowered; pedicel 1–1.5 cm long. Buds ovate; ca 6 x 4 mm, hairy. Flowers white or yellowish. Sepals linear-lanceolate; 5–7 x 1–1.5 mm, hairy on outer part. Petals in 2 part; the upper obtrullate, ca 8 x 2 mm; the lower part bowl-shaped; these two parts connected by an appendix. Ovary ovoid, hairy, style single up to 1 mm long; stigma with narrow apex. Fruit pear-shaped, ca 25 x 10 cm, fleshy and indehiscent. Seeds ovoid, up to 1 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Theobroma cacao. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 651. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herbs or undershrubs, up to 1 m high. Stipules caducous. Leaves simple, alternate, ovate to oblong, 3–7 x 2–3.5 cm, subcoriaceous, apex acute to obtuse, base cordate or obtuse, woolly especially on lower surface, serrate, doubly serrate or crenate; 3–(5) basal nerves, secondary nerves 3–5 pairs, ascending, scalariform conspicuous on lower surface. Petioles 0.5–2 cm, hairy. Inflorescences in a sessile or pedunculate cluster, axillary and terminal. Flowers yellow to reddish-yellow, each surrounded by a pair of hairy bracts. Calyx with 5 narrow triangular lobes on the upper half, hispid. Petals free, linear or spoon-shaped with a shallow hook upward, 1.5–3 x 0.5 mm, hairy externally and glabrous within, ciliate along margin. Ovary oblong, ca 5 x 1 mm, hispid; style subulate with a narrow pointed stigma, hairy. Fruit ovoid, with an acute, hooked apex, ca 2 x 1 mm. Seed black, shining.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Waltheria indica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 651. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Fronds boat-shaped, 0.5–0.8 mm long, 1.6–2.5 times as long as wide, 2–3 times as deep as wide, the greatest width at the surface of the water, with 8–10(–25) stomata, whitish green on the surface with more intensely green margins. Flowers rare.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Fronds ellipsoid, 0.4–0.8 mm long, 1.3–2 times as long as wide, 1–1.5 times as deep as wide, the greatest width slightly below the surface of the water, with 1–10(–30) stomata, rather pale and somewhat transparently green on the surface. Flowers rare.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Wolffia globosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 398. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Trees to 30 m. Axillary buds glabrous or scales with a ciliate margin, 0.7–1.1 mm long, sometimes up to 0.7 mm stipitate, usually in axil or occasionally up to 1 mm above it. Axil occasionally swollen, nodal glands ca 0.5 by 1 mm. Leaves ovate to elliptic; apex acuminate (tip 0.5–2.0 cm long); base rounded or cuneate becoming attenuate, 5–11 by 2–4 cm, length to width ratio 2.2–3.8; margin undulate due to glands which appear as thickenings along margin; underside smooth or minutely papillose, but not glaucous, with 2–9 glands on lamina, 0–8 on margin, 0.3–0.8 mm; midrib sunken above, prominent below; secondary veins 6–9, forming an intramarginal vein from halfway or in the upper third; tertiary veins reticulate, almost as prominent as secondaries; petiole 5–7 mm. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, rarely branched, but occasionally 2 inflorescences per axil, glabrous to sparsely short hairy, nodal glands present. Flowers white, blackish-red when dried; pedicel 2.5–3 mm, outer sepals 3.8–4.5 mm, inner sepals ca 5.5 mm, upper petals 7–9 mm; lateral petals 6.5–10 mm; keel 6.5–7 mm; keel equal to shorter than other petals. Sepals glabrous inside and out, with ciliate margins; upper petals glabrous outside, densely hairy to near the apex inside; lateral petals glabrous or hairy almost to apex inside; keel glabrous outside, shortly hairy along middle inside. Stamens 6–7 mm, triadelphous, with the upper and lateral epipetalous stamens connate with the alternipetalous stamens, and the keel stamens connate with each other, anthers 0.4 mm. Gynoecium 6–7 mm, stipe 0.5–1.0 mm, ovules 8–14; ovary and style glabrous. Fruit globular, to 2 cm diameter, glabrous; seed 1.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Xanthophyllum ellipticum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 526. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 20 m. Axillary buds and sometimes base of petiole and axil hairy, buds 0.5–0.9 mm long, not stalked, all buds within the axil. Leaves ovate to elliptic-oblong, occasionally obovate; apex acuminate (tip 0.5–2.0 cm long); base rounded or cuneate, 6–11 by 2–5.5 cm, length to width ratio 1.7–3.5; margin undulate; underside smooth, with 1–5 glands, 0.2–0.4 mm, or up to 0.5 mm along veins; midrib sunken or flat with central groove above; secondary veins 3–6, looping and forming a distinct intramarginal vein; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole 4–10 mm. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, usually solitary, occasionally 2-branched, very short sparsely to densely patently hairy. Flowers white, upper petals yellow inside at base, keel sometimes with pink hue, orange-yellow when dried; pedicel 2–3 mm, outer sepals 1.5–2.5 mm, inner sepals 3.0–3.5 mm; upper petals 6–8 mm, hairy only inside at base; lateral petals 6–8 mm, glabrous or hairy inside at base; keel 6.5–8 mm, hairy inside at base or sparsely throughout, outside only along middle in upper half; keel usually almost equal to other petals. Stamens 6–8 mm; anthers 0.4–0.5 mm. Gynoecium 6–7.5 mm, shortly stipitate (ca. 0.5 mm), ovules 4; ovary densely hairy, style sparsely hairy. Fruit globular, to 2 cm diameter, more or less tuberculate, densely shortly hairy, grey green; seeds 1 or 2.

description: Tree to 30 m. Axillary buds densely hairy or occasionally glabrous, 0.6–1.6 mm long, not stalked, all buds within the axil. Leaves elliptic, oblong, ovate or obovate; apex blunt or acuminate (tip to 1.5 cm long); base attenuate or cuneate; 4.5–20 by 1.5–10 cm, length to width ratio 2.4–3.8; margin flat or undulate; underside smooth, with 0–17 glands, sometimes with a basal pair, 0.3–1.5 mm; midrib slightly prominent above; secondary veins 4–10, usually forming an intramarginal vein from halfway, but sometimes intramarginal vein indistinct; tertiary veins scalariform; petioles sometimes minutely hairy, 6–11 mm. Inflorescence with up to 4 branches, occasionally 2 inflorescences per axil, with sparse erect hairs or densely grey or yellow downy, glabrescent or persistent, occasionally with nodal glands. Flowers white or yellow, yellow-orange when dried; pedicel 3–7 mm, outer sepals 2.5–4.0 mm, inner sepals 3.0–5.5 mm; upper petals 6–11 mm, inside glabrous or hairy in lower half, outside glabrous or hairy at apex; lateral petals 6.5–14 mm, inside glabrous or hairy at base, outside glabrous or hairy at base; keel 6–13 mm, hairiness variable, but always hairy in upper half outside; lateral petals longest, either keel or upper petals shortest. Stamens 5.5–12 mm; anthers 0.4–0.9 mm. Gynoecium 6–10 mm, stipe 0.5–1.0 mm, ovules 8–12; ovary glabrous, style densely hairy. Fruit globular or markedly beaked, 1–2 cm in diameter, smooth or ribbed, glabrous except at apex or on ribs, seeds 1 or 2.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 15 m. Axillary buds almost glabrous or very shortly hairy, sometimes shortly stipitate, 2.5–5(–7) mm long, within axil. Leaves elliptic to lanceolate; apex acuminate (tip 0.5–0.7 cm long); base attenuate; 6.5–18 by 2.0–5.5 cm, length to width ratio 2.7–4.0; margin slightly undulate, sometimes inrolled at base; underside glaucous papillose, with 2–16(–30) rather indistinct glands 0.15–0.2 mm, sometimes with a basal pair, 0.5 by 0.7 mm; midrib slightly raised above; secondary veins (4–)6–9, forming an indistinct intramarginal vein in apical half; tertiary veins reticulate; petioles 10–15 mm. Inflorescence with up to 7 branches, shortly patent hairy, glabrescent, nodal glands absent. Flowers white, the upper petals yellow towards the base yellow, yellow or orange when dried; pedicel 2.5–3.0 mm, outer sepals 2.5 mm, inner sepals 3.5 mm; upper petals 6.0–7.0 mm, hairy only inside at base; lateral petals 7.0 mm, hairy only inside at base; keel 6.0 mm, hairy at the base inside and along the middle outside. Stamens 6.5 mm; anthers 0.6–0.7 mm. Gynoecium 6.0 mm, stipe 0.5 mm, ovules 4; ovary densely hairy, style sparsely hairy. Fruit globular, ca 2 cm in diameter, green, slightly glaucous, sparsely hairy; seeds 1 or 2.

description: Tree to 20 m. Twigs glabrous. Axillary buds 3–4, slightly hairy, to 2 mm long, the upper bud usually stipitate and up to 4 mm supra-axillary, though sometimes all buds sessile and axillary. Leaves oblong to elliptic, though sometimes rather irregularly shaped; apex acuminate (tip to 1 cm long); base cuneate; 6–14 by 1.8–4 cm, length to width ratio 3.3–4.5; margin somewhat irregular, slightly inrolled; underside glaucous papillose, with 5–20 glands, 0.1–0.6 mm, basal pair absent; midrib prominent above; secondary veins 5–8, not forming a distinct intramarginal vein; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole glabrous, 5–7 mm. Inflorescence terminal or axillary, up to 12-branched, longer or shorter than leaves, rather sparsely hairy. Flowers white, orange-red when dried; pedicel 2.5–4 mm, outer sepals 1–2 mm, inner sepals 1.8–3 mm; upper petals ca 5–7 mm, sparsely hairy inside to halfway or densely hairy to apex and with a tuft of hairs outside at apex; lateral petals 5–7 mm, completely glabrous or hairy inside to halfway; keel 4–7 mm, auriculate, densely hairy outside at apex, more sparsely along midrib inside and outside. Stamens 3.5–7 mm, hairy in basal half or almost glabrous, anthers 0.2–0.5 mm. Gynoecium 4–6 mm, very shortly stipitate (ca. 0.2 mm), ovules 4; ovary and style almost glabrous, with a few loosely appressed hairs. Fruit unknown.

description: Tree to 25 m. Axillary buds glabrous, 2–6 mm long, not stalked, sometimes within axil and enclosed by slight swelling of the twig. Leaves ovate to elliptic; apex acute to shortly acuminate (tip to 0.3 cm long); base rounded or truncate, shortly attenuate; 4–8.5 by 1.8–5.5 cm, length to width ratio 1.6–2.2; margin flat or undulate, smooth below, with 4–6 glands, sometimes with a basal pair, 0.2 mm; midrib slightly raised above; secondary veins 5–6, forming an indistinct intramarginal vein in apical half; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole 8–13 mm. Inflorescence longer than the leaves, with up to 5 branches, shortly patently hairy, nodal glands absent. Flowers white with a yellow apex; pedicel 1–4.5 mm, outer sepals 1.6–2.5 mm, inner sepals 2.6–3.3 mm; petals up to 6.5–7.8 mm, the keel densely hairy outside, other petals glabrous or hairy at apex outside. Stamens widened above the base, with a densely hairy swelling on the inside, above sparsely hairy only below anthers; anthers 0.4 mm. Gynoecium 6–7 mm, stipe 0.5–2.0 mm, ovules 4; ovary densely hairy, style sparsely hairy. Fruit brown, globular, to 1.1 cm in diameter, appressed hairy; seeds 1 or 2.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 15 m. Axillary buds hairy, 0.8–1.5 mm long, not stalked, buds within axil, or very rarely up to 2 mm above it. Leaves 3–13 by 1.0–4.5 cm, length to width ratio 1.6–5.8; elliptic to lanceolate; apex rounded to shortly (tip to 0.3 cm long) acuminate; base attenuate or cuneate; margin flat, inrolled at base; underside glaucous papillose, with 4–40 glands, sometimes with a basal pair, 0.2–0.5 mm; midrib flat or sunken; secondary veins 8–13, forming an indistinct intramarginal vein for whole length; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole 3–7 mm. Inflorescence longer than the leaves, with up to 6 branches, densely patent to sparsely appressed hairy, nodal glands absent. Flowers white or purple-white, turning yellow, yellow or orange when dried; pedicel 1–2 mm, outer sepals 1.8–2.0 mm, inner sepals 2.5–3.4 mm; upper petals 7.5–9.5 mm, glabrous, or hairy inside at base and outside at apex; lateral petals 7.0–9.5 mm, glabrous, or hairy inside at base and outside at apex, occasionally also inside at apex; keel 6.5–8.0 mm, hairy inside at base or along middle, outside densely hairy especially in middle; upper petals longest and keel shortest. Stamens 6–8 mm; anthers 0.3–0.6 mm. Gynoecium 6–7 mm, stipe 0.2–0.3 mm, ovules 4; ovary densely hairy, style sparsely hairy. Fruit globular, 1.7–3.8 cm in diameter, green, glabrous; seeds 1 or 2.

description: Tree to ca 50 m. Pitted nodal glands 0.3 x 0.6 mm usually present. Axillary bud scales with a ciliate margin but otherwise glabrous, 1.0–2.0 mm long, not stalked, all buds within the axil. Leaves ovate to elliptic; apex rounded to shortly (tip to 0.5 cm long) acuminate; base cuneate to attenuate; 5–19 by 2–7.5 cm, length to width ratio 2.0–3.3; margin slightly undulate; underside smooth, with 0–8 glands, 0.4–0.5 mm, without a basal pair; midrib prominent above and below, shallowly grooved above; secondary veins 5–9, not forming a distinct intramarginal vein except sometimes at apex; tertiary veins reticulate and obscure; petiole 6–11 mm. Inflorescence unbranched, sparsely minutely hairy, without nodal glands. Flowers white, drying blackish-red; pedicel ca 5 mm, outer sepals ca 4.0 mm, inner sepals ca 6.0 mm; upper petals ca 13 mm, glabrous or densely hairy at base and apex; lateral petals ca 15 mm, glabrous; keel ca 13 mm, glabrous. Stamens 8–9 mm; anthers 1.0 mm. Gynoecium 8.0 mm, stipe 1.0, ovules 8–18; ovary and style glabrous. Fruit globular, to 10 cm diameter, glabrous; seeds 8–16.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 10 m. Axillary buds 2–4, glabrous to hairy, 0.7–1.5 mm long, occasionally on a stalk up to 1.5 mm long, the uppermost bud 1–6 mm above axil. Leaves ovate or lanceolate to elliptic; apex acute to acuminate (tip to 0.8 cm long); base cuneate to attenuate; 5–10 by 2–5 cm, length to width ratio 2.1–3.5; margin slightly undulate; underside glaucous papillose, with 0–45 glands, 0.1–0.2 mm, without a basal pair; midrib sunken, flat or slightly raised above; secondary veins 5–7, forming an intramarginal vein in the top third or occasionally top half of the leaf; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole 5–12 mm. Inflorescence shorter than the leaves, with up to 3 branches, but may have up to 7 inflorescences on a leafless twig giving the impression of a long, very branched inflorescence, yellowish patently hairy, usually markedly more dense on pedicel, without nodal glands. Flowers white, drying yellow or orange; pedicel 4.5–6 mm, outer sepals 3–4 mm, inner sepals 4.5–5 mm; upper petals 12–14 mm, hairy inside and outside in lower half, sometimes outside at apex; lateral petals 10–13 mm, hairy inside at base, outside at base and apex; keel 9–12 mm, hairy inside at base and along middle, outside at apex or throughout; either all petals equal or keel shortest. Stamens 7–11 mm; anthers 0.5–0.7 mm. Gynoecium 9–11 mm, stipe 0.5–1.0 mm, ovules 4; ovary densely hairy, style densely to sparsely hairy. Fruit globular, to 1.6 cm diameter, glabrous; seeds 1.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 30 m. Patent nodal appendages (0.1 mm diameter) usually present. Axillary buds glabrous or with a tuft of hairs at the apex, sometimes with a ciliate margin, 0.8–1.3 mm long, not stalked, all buds within 1.5 mm of the axil. Leaves ovate or elliptic to oblong; apex acuminate (tip 0.4–1 cm long); base rounded to cuneate; 5–15 by 2–5.5 cm, length to width ratio 1.9–3.8; margin flat to slightly undulate; underside smooth, with few to numerous (40) glands, 0.2–0.3 mm or up to 0.7 mm along veins, without a basal pair; midrib above slightly raised to almost flat, with a pronounced central groove towards the base; secondary veins 7–9, intramarginal vein in the upper half or indistinct; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole 4–8 mm. Inflorescence with up to 4 branches, very densely patently hairy, without nodal glands. Flowers white, yellow at the base of the upper petals, drying yellow or orange; pedicel 2–2.5 mm, outer sepals 1.5–2.1 mm, inner sepals 2–2.2 mm; upper petals 6–7 mm, glabrous or hairy inside at base; lateral petals 6–7 mm, hairy inside at base, sometimes outside at apex; keel 6 mm, hairy inside at base or along middle, outside along middle; either all petals equal or keel shortest. Stamens 4–5 mm; anthers 0.3 mm. Gynoecium 5.5 mm, stipe < 0.3 mm, ovules 4; ovary densely hairy, style sparsely hairy. Fruit globular, to 7 cm long, glabrous; seeds 1–4.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 30 m. Axillary buds glabrous, 0.8–2.1 mm long, sometimes on a stalk up to 0.8 mm, the uppermost bud 2–15 mm above the axil. Leaves ovate to elliptic or obovate, sometimes rather irregularly formed; apex acute to acuminate (tip to 1 cm long); base rounded to attenuate, sometimes unequal; 7–20 by 2–6.5 cm, length to width ratio 2.1–4.5; margin flat to slightly undulate; underside smooth to papillose glaucous, with 2–6 glands of diameter 0.3–0.6 mm, or up to 40 smaller (0.1–0.2 mm) glands which are irregularly formed and appear as distortions along the veins; occasionally with a basal pair; midrib above very slightly raised, with or without grooves in basal part; secondary veins (4–)5–13 , intramarginal vein in the upper half or indistinct; tertiary veins reticulate; petioles 4–12 mm. Inflorescence terminal or supra axillary, shorter or longer than the leaves, with up to 8 branches, but may have up to 10 inflorescences on one leafless twig; moderately dense yellow patently hairy, without nodal glands. Flowers white or pale lilac, yellow at the base of the upper petals, drying yellow, orange or rarely pale pink; pedicel 3–4 mm, outer sepals 1–2 mm, inner sepals 1.5–2.5 mm; upper petals 5–7 mm, hairy only inside at base; lateral petals 5–7.5 mm, glabrous or only hairy inside at base; keel 5.5–7 mm, inside glabrous or hairy at base or apex, outside hairy in upper third; keel may be either the shortest or longest petal. Stamens 4.5–7 mm; anthers 0.4–0.5 mm. Gynoecium 5–7 mm, stipe 0.3–0.6 mm, ovules 4; ovary densely hairy, style glabrous to hairy. Fruit globular up to 3.5 cm diameter, glabrous to glaucous or very shortly sparsely hairy, pale green; seeds 1 or 2.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Xanthophyllum virens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 536. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 30 m. Axillary buds glabrous, strongly thickened at the base, not stalked, all buds within the axil, 3–11 mm long. Leaves elliptic to oblong, apex acute to acuminate (tip to 1.0 cm long); base rounded or acute, slightly decurrent; 7–14 by 3–6 cm, length to width ratio 2.0–2.6; margin slightly undulate; underside smooth, with 3–8 glands of diameter 0.2–0.5 mm, sometimes with a basal pair; midrib above prominent and without grooves; secondary veins 6–9, intramarginal vein distinct in apical half; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole glabrous 8–12 mm. Inflorescence with up to 6 branches; densely patently hairy, without nodal glands. Flowers yellow, drying orange red; pedicel 1–2 mm, outer sepals 1.7–2 mm, inner sepals 2.3–3 mm; upper petals ca 8 mm, glabrous except outside at apex and occasionally sparsely at base; lateral petals ca 7.5 mm, glabrous outside except at apex, inside glabrous; keel 6.5 mm, hairy outside along middle, glabrous inside; keel shorter than the other petals. Stamens swollen above base and hairy there, ca 6 mm; anthers ca 0.5 mm. Gynoecium 6 mm, stipe 0.3 mm, ovules 4; ovary densely patently hairy, style sparsely hairy in basal half only. Fruit globular, up to 1.5 cm diameter, glabrous and densely tuberculate; seeds 1 or 2.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Xanthophyllum vitellinum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 3, 2001. Pg. 537. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 10 m. Axillary buds hairy to densely hairy, 0.8–2.0 mm long, not stalked, all buds within the axil. Leaves ovate to oblong, apex acute to acuminate (tip to 2.5 cm long); base rounded to truncate or cordate; 6–28 by 2.3–10 cm, length to width ratio 2.0–3.1; margin almost flat; underside smooth or minutely hairy, with 0 or 1 gland of diameter 0.4–0.6 mm; midrib above sunken and hairy, especially towards base; secondary veins 6–13, with many intermediate veins not reaching margin, intramarginal vein usually distinct from the base; tertiary veins reticulate; petiole stout and hairy, at least in the upper groove, 6–12 mm. Inflorescence with up to 2 branches, densely patently hairy, without nodal glands. Flowers white or lilac, yellow at the base of the upper petals, drying yellow or orange; pedicel ca 2 mm, outer sepals 2–3.5 mm, inner sepals 3–4 mm; upper petals 7–10 mm, hairy inside to at least half-way, outside at apex and occasionally at base; lateral petals 6.5–9.5 mm, inside hairy at least at base, outside glabrous or hairy at apex; keel 6–9 mm, hairy outside throughout, inside along middle; keel equal to or shorter than the other petals. Stamens 5.5–8 mm; anthers 0.4–0.6 mm. Gynoecium 5.5–7.5 mm, stipe 0.6–0.8 mm, ovules 4; ovary densely hairy, style sparsely hairy. Fruit globular, up to 1.5 cm diameter, glabrous and densely tuberculate; seeds 1 or 2.
creator: Rachun Pooma
